title: Actual free-chart functions and their ordered nonunit indices
statement: Let W be a scheme and N an etale log structure [def-trf-fs-log-blowup]. For a monoid map beta from the multiplicative free additive monoid (ULift(Fin r) -> N) to N(W), define coordinate(i) as the structural image of beta of the i-th standard basis vector. Its ordinaryCoordinate at w is its Zariski germ. Its strictCoordinate at a geometric point t is its pointed etale ring germ [def-trf-log-regular-pair] carried through the canonical strict-local ring comparison [def-trf-log-etale-restriction-stalk-comparison]. Define nonunitIndices as the list of the ULift lifts of 0,...,r-1 filtered by noninvertibility of ordinaryCoordinate at w. These constructions retain the actual chart values, their multiplicities and their increasing index order; r=0 gives the empty list.

source.place: Expose VI, 1.2 and 1.6--1.7, printed pp. 69--70; characteristic faces and descent of free chart parameters, extracted from returned proof steps 7--8.
